capabilities: connect to multiple IMAP and SMTP accounts
read, filter, and organize messages with flags, moves, and bulk actions
compose, reply, forward, and manage drafts over SMTP
save messages as Markdown notes in a vault folder
cache folders and messages locally in IndexedDB
extras: Distributed as an Early Access build outside the community plugin directory; installed via BRAT or manual copy. README warns of possible destructive IMAP edge cases and recommends starting with a non-critical mailbox.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in email support, so users must leave the vault or a separate mail client to read, organize, and reference messages.
summary: Desktop IMAP and SMTP email client for Obsidian that syncs folders via IMAP IDLE, manages messages, and saves them as Markdown notes.
